content: Los Angeles, California, has an average elevation of about 305 feet (93 meters) above sea level. However, the elevation can vary significantly across the city due to its diverse topography, with some areas being much higher, particularly in the foothills and nearby mountains. For instance, the San Gabriel Mountains to the northeast of the city have peaks that exceed 10,000 feet (3,048 meters).
